concepts.title: Vasúti atlasz
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished desktop GAMEPLAY SCREEN UI concept for the existing isometric railway logistics game Terepasztal. Single landscape 16:9 screen, ideally 1920x1080 or larger. Reference image is ART DIRECTION ONLY, not a collage layout to reproduce. World: orthographic 2:1 isometric richly illustrated miniature pastoral valley, no horizon or sky, cream limestone station with slate roof, small green steam locomotive and timber wagons, looping rails and sidings, stone bridge over teal river, wheat fields, clustered village, rounded trees, warm painterly light. Preserve at least 60% of screen as visible playable world. UI must look designed for a sophisticated PC logistics game with generous readable typography and coherent icons, not a mobile game or web dashboard. Show meaningful functional hierarchy: top resource counters wood 240, stone 180, coal 96, water 320, wheat 150 and money 12,480; Steam Age badge; day 24, 10:30 and pause/1x/2x controls. Left compact objective card 'Supply the town', 'Deliver timber 32 / 60'. Right selected train inspector 'Valley Express', 'Running', coal and water gauges, cargo 'Timber 24 / 40', three-stop route 'Pinewood > Riverside > Depot', buttons 'Follow' and 'Schedule'. Bottom construction palette with illustrated miniature icons and labels 'Tracks', 'Stations', 'Buildings', 'Signals', 'Landscape', with Tracks selected; small minimap bottom left. Amber alert 'Low water at Riverside' with icon and wording, not color only. English UI text for clear mockup typography. No extraneous captions outside interface, no concept-board grid, no device frame, no watermark. These are concept mockups, not exact game screenshots. ART DIRECTION A — RAILWAY ATLAS. Warm ivory paper floating panels, extremely subtle paper grain, deep forest green typography, hairline muted brass borders, tiny cartographic corner marks. Handsome editorial serif only for panel headings, very readable humanist sans for values/body. Light rounded 8px corners, gentle layered shadows. Illustration thumbnails feel like a premium illustrated railway field guide. Active tool is solid forest green with ivory label. Route shown as fine green railway line with three station dots. Tactile and mature, refined rather than distressed. Avoid thick ornamental frames, medieval fantasy, leather, rivets, neon and dark RPG bevels.

A very clean warm contemporary game UI for a richly painted miniature world. Opaque chalk-ivory floating cards, generous whitespace, soft 14px corners, gentle diffuse shadows, olive/forest green accents, restrained clay-orange warnings. Entirely rounded humanist sans typography, excellent number alignment, crisp fine line icons mixed with small hand-painted asset thumbnails. Compact pill resource groups top left, clock controls top right. Right inspector is a clean ivory card with spacious sections, modern horizontal fuel bars, route timeline. Bottom construction dock floats centered in a compact pill tray with six generous tool slots; Tracks clearly selected with pale sage fill and green outline. Keep interface calm and lightweight, illustration is star. Avoid glass transparency, neon, medieval ornament, wood frames and mobile-game oversized buttons.
